safety_verdicts.content: Prescribed a steroid cream to be used twice daily (BD).
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies steroid cream twice daily (BD); Generated notes starting a steroid cream but does not include BD/twice-daily frequency.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the twice-daily (BD) dosing instruction for the prescribed topical steroid can lead to under- or over-application, reducing treatment effectiveness or increasing risk of local adverse effects (e.g., skin thinning/irritation), particularly if the patient applies it more frequently to seek relief. This is a treatment-plan clarity error affecting symptom control but is unlikely to cause serious harm in the short term for hand dermatitis.
